clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Stockade, Kam Deepfury waits apart from the Defias rebels. The Dark Iron dwarf was captured after arranging the blast that shattered the Thandol Span, far to the north.

Kam Deepfury is a Dark Iron dwarf held deep in the Stormwind Stockade. Most prisoners there are disgruntled Stonemasons or Defias rebels, but he belongs to neither. Captured and brought to Stormwind after an operation crippled vital northern infrastructure, he remains cut off from his kin beneath Blackrock Mountain. Like the rebels who share the corridors, he is hostile to the Alliance.

Alliance intelligence at Dun Modr, near the Wetlands' northern border, named Kam Deepfury as the chief architect of the blast that shattered the Thandol Span. The explosion severed one of the massive stone bridges linking the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. It crippled a vital trade and military route for Ironforge and the Alliance, and killed a kin of the dwarf commander Longbraid the Grim.
